# Golden Crumb
> Artisan Cookies in San Francisco

Golden Crumb is an artisan cookie brand based in San Francisco, CA. We bake small-batch cookies fresh daily using premium ingredients — real butter, fresh eggs, and high-quality chocolate. Our cookies are perfect for everyday treats, thoughtful gifts, and sweet moments.

## Summary

Golden Crumb offers freshly baked artisan cookies made in small batches. We serve San Francisco with local delivery. Cookies are handcrafted with premium ingredients and baked fresh to order.
